correctness.rationale: For one initial additive parasitoid pulse q, direct recurrence gives H3=R^3H0 exp[-a(P0+q)-W+(1-R)Y+R Y exp(Y-W)] with W=acH0 and Y=W exp[-a(P0+q)]. H1 and H2 strictly decrease with q. The logarithmic H3 derivative divided by a equals G=-1+(R-1)Y-RY(1+Y)exp(Y-W), with G double-prime=-R exp(Y-W)(4+5Y+Y^2)<0. For R>1, positive G iff W>F_R(y)=y+log(Ry(1+y)/((R-1)y-1)); F_R has a unique global minimizer from the cubic derivative, giving the exact W_c and at most two positive stationary doses. Root order and decreasing Y(q) give the three starting-exposure cases, including tangencies. R<=1 gives negative derivative. Direct symbolic differentiation independently verified the H3 formula and dose derivative; exact R=3,H0=6,P0=log3,q=log2 demonstrates third-generation reversal.
